items.name: Thanks Four The Invite 2018
items.information:
* **The cost of registration is a $15 flat fee. Payments are taken after registering. We will not be taking registrations or payments at the door.**
* Registration closes January 6th at 11:59 PM PST, or earlier if we reach the 150 competitor limit.
* Spectating is free and open the the public. Photography and videography are permitted, however there shall be **NO FLASH PHOTOGRAPHY.**
* Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years - thanks!

items.name: South Enough 2018
items.information:
The first ever competition in Santa Cruz, CA!
To register, click on the 'Register' button at left (desktop) or near the top (mobile).
Registration is completed after signing up on this website, and paying $25 via Stripe.

**If your are a new competitor, please read the New Competitor Tab**

All competitors are expected to be available to judge/scramble/run at all times. If you would like to volunteer to judge/scramble/run, please use the contact email provided on this page.

items.name: PDX Cubing for Causes 2018
items.information:
This competition will have a 180 competitor limit.

Before registering, **you must read the "Competitor Responsibilities" tab**. This tab details the responsibilites of all competitors at this competition.

items.name: Northern Neck Winter 2018

venue.name: Oak Grove Baptist Church
venue.details: The competition is in the gym of the church, there are signs directing you to the competition.

items.information: There is a 90 competitor limit for Northern Neck Winter 2018 on a first come, first serve basis. Registration is $15 and is to be paid online. Unfortunately, we cannot accept registration or payment at the door, and your registration is not complete until payment is complete. Spectators and guests however, can come into the venue for free, and lunch is paid for with your registration fee. If you have a specific food allergy, please email the organizers as soon as possible.

items.name: New York City Winter 2018
items.information: There is a **100** competitor limit. Your registration is not considered complete until you have registered and paid (via Stripe payment). We are not accepting any registrations or payments at the door.

items.name: Michigan Cubing Club Alpha 2018
items.information:
There is a registration fee of $10 which must be paid through the WCA website before your registration is complete. Please allow up to 48 hours for your registration to be accepted after payment is submitted.
Specators may attend for free
There is a limit of 110 competitors.
